title: Record encoding of a configuration
statement: Let $k,s	ext{ be natural numbers}$, let $Q,T$ be types, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on input $x$, with tag $	au	ext{ in }T$. Its record is a list of fields: first the current state; then the binary digits of the shifted input-head position, using width equal to the binary length of $|x|+1$; then, for each work tape, the cells at positions $-s,-s+1,\\ldots,s$, each recording its content and whether its head is there; and finally a field containing $	au$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on input $x$
